payload.summary: Wave-1 committee review (codex + cursor, one tight round each): REVISE — 7 unique findings (6 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM) + 1 nit, all verified real: (1) config set byte-equal no-op blocks the documented provenance repair (both reviewers); (2) startRun before composeInvocation can orphan an active run on schema-valid config (both); (3) shell injection in the paste-ready routing fix via unescaped quotes; (4) provenance forgeable — nahel log accepts the config.updated event type; (5) same-second config events can mis-order and wrongly authorize auto-merge (the known tie-break weakness biting a security surface); (6) itemless dispatch skips the run record the F1.1 AC requires — --item becomes required; (7) codex shims ignore CODEX_HOME. Opus fixer agent dispatched with the combined list; re-review verify-only after.
